boredom is a very common state, is very persistent, is associated with poorer learning outcomes and with gaming the system, and is the most important state to respond to in order to increase learning.
boredom is very persistent and is the most detrimental state to learning, whereas frustration is not very persistent and does not appear to be detrimental to learning.

the design of learning environments that are more engaging for learners and that promote more effective learning.
